section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1973
title: The all India average recorded 65·5 per cent deaths among males and this ratio is almost maintained by most of the states except for a few where male involvement was still more. The male involvement was cent per cent in the case of Lakshadweep and Mizoram. The percentage of male involvement in the accidental deaths in the Metropolitan cities was 69·4 per cent and this did not vary much from the all India average. The details are given in Table V. TABLE V Statewise distribution of Accidental Deaths by Sex, 1973
